artificial_analysis.label: Artificial Analysis
artificial_analysis.subtitle: Broad capability
artificial_analysis.qualification: Source-native Intelligence Index v5.0.2 (CritPt v2 regrade across the 9-benchmark v5 suite), not a Model Atlas aggregate. Reasoning effort and fallback settings are distinct entries, including configurations collapsed under release groups on the source page. Public table scores are rounded integers; equal displayed scores share a rank here. No confidence intervals are published in this table. Cost per task is not API price per million tokens; a rounded $0.00 is not proof of free usage. The source's current-model view is not a guarantee of public availability.
warnings: Evaluation/publication date not supplied by the table; observed date is retrieval only.
artificial_analysis.scope: Complete scored current-model roster (including grouped effort variants)

arena_text.label: Arena
arena_text.subtitle: Human preference
arena_text.qualification: Official text_style_control dataset, overall category only. Not the raw text, coding, or agent board. Retains the full source roster, including historical models. A recent board publication does not mean every model was recently released or re-evaluated. Source 95% intervals and vote counts are preserved; adjacent ranks are not claims of statistical separation.

livebench.label: LiveBench
livebench.subtitle: Task performance
livebench.qualification: LiveBench 2.0 official release feed, NOT the retired LiveBench overall benchmark. Overall is the source's weighted mean (Long Agentic ×2; Design and Coding ×1.5; other suites ×1). Suites are single runs; effort is highest supported unless the source's model notes say otherwise. No per-model confidence intervals are supplied. Missing suite results stay missing, not zero. Cost is per successful task.
warnings: Stale snapshot (15 days); not a current ranking.

terminal_bench.label: Terminal-Bench
terminal_bench.subtitle: Model + agent systems
terminal_bench.qualification: SYSTEM ranking: model + reasoning setting + agent harness on Terminal-Bench 4.1. Mixed harnesses must not be interpreted as an isolated model comparison. No best-agent cherry-picking or reuse in the legacy Terminal-Bench composite slots. Release dates are model release dates, NOT evaluation dates. Published ± margins reflect the source's 95% confidence half-widths across evaluation trials.
terminal_bench.scope: Complete official display roster (all evaluated model + agent systems)

policy: Source-native scores only. No cross-board averaging or inferred model equivalence.
